statement: Anthropic committed to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of MI450-series GPUs in Helios, with the first gigawatt beginning deployment in the first half of 2027, and Microsoft will deploy Helios at scale on Azure for frontier model inferencing.
why: Named, sized commitments from a frontier lab and a hyperscaler are the hardest evidence that non-NVIDIA accelerators are being designed into large production fleets.

impact.mechanism: Gigawatt-scale named deployments convert AMD's roadmap into committed demand and pull forward matching power and datacenter capacity.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic will deploy up to 2 gigawatts of MI450 series GPUs in Helios, with deployment of the first gigawatt beginning in the first half of 2027.
Microsoft will deploy Helios at scale on Azure for frontier model inferencing.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript of management's own remarks; figure is an 'up to' ceiling and no single-customer revenue-concentration percentage was disclosed.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: AMD Investor Relations (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.), Investing.com (AMD Q2 2026 earnings call transcript)
